name: marketing-agent
description: Jordi Driesen's marketing plugin: a team of subagents plus the skill library they run on, in one install.

plugins.name: marketing-agent
plugins.description: A marketing team for Claude: a director that runs each job in the main thread with the plugin's skills, thirteen specialist thread profiles it starts only where they pay off, and a cold reviewer with review tiers. 50 skills, five of them family skills. Client brand kits stay private and load via the [brand]-brand-kit naming pattern. Web development calls WordPress skills from the separate wordpress-development plugin.
